app_type: Financial Management SaaS Dashboard for Barbershops

headings.instructions: Use for all headings, KPIs, and major data points. Install via Google Fonts or standard imports. Use tracking-tight for sizes above 32px.

body.instructions: Use for tables, body text, forms, and secondary information.

colors.description: Deep charcoal/obsidian base with muted off-white text to reduce glare. Use Emerald and Crimson for financial indicators.

css_variables_update.instructions_to_main_agent: Overwrite the .dark class in src/index.css with these variables. Remove the light mode variables or ensure the app forces the .dark class on the body/html tag permanently, as this is a dark-only app.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid backgrounds with 1px borders (border-border). Do not use soft shadows on the dark theme. Build layered surfaces by using slightly lighter grays for elevated cards/modals.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid glassmorphism for financial data. Use solid backgrounds to prevent visual refraction of data.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton for tabular/dense data using border-collapse and subtle borders (border-border). For cards, use rounded-lg with 1px border.

grids_and_layouts.pattern: High Density Grid (Bento Grid Mode B)
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense and compact spacing for the dashboard (gap-4 or gap-6). Use generous spacing (p-6 or p-8) inside cards to prevent text collision.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Always start with grid-cols-1. Ensure tables overflow horizontally gracefully on mobile.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_anatomy: Collapsible or icon-based left sidebar/bottom nav for mobile. Top-left emphasis for main KPI (e.g. Lucro Real / Disponível). Modular widgets.

components.strategy: Use Shadcn UI components extensively (Card, Table, Dialog, Select, Input, Tabs, Button). Do not build complex interactions from scratch.
components.charts: Use Shadcn Chart components (Recharts). Ensure chart colors match the dark theme and are accessible. Avoid decorative charts; stick to functional Line, Bar, and Doughnut charts.
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a professional, dense dashboard look, or Lucide React if already installed. Keep strokes thin and legible.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialogs for adding revenues, expenses, or configuring machines.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Add transitions for specific interactive elements (hover, focus). DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Example: 'transition-colors duration-200'.
motion_and_interactions.hovers: Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-secondary hover:text-foreground).
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Subtle scale down on button click (active:scale-95). Subtle lifts on dashboard cards if needed, but prefer border color changes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards. Off-white on charcoal is great. Ensure positive (green) and negative (red) text on dark backgrounds is legible (use lighter shades of green/red).
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast. Use ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-background.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-revenue-button').

general_ui_ux_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds for components with overlapping content (e.g., Dropdowns, Modals, Sticky Headers).
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Do NOT apply 'text-align: center' globally to the app.
Do NOT use emoji characters as icons. Use professional SVG icons.
Format all currency values consistently as BRL (e.g., R$ 1.500,00).
Provide a 'Limpar Dados' (Clear Data) button strictly for the demo/mock phase.
Ensure all mock data calculation logic works (Bruto -> Taxa -> Líquido -> Comissão -> Barbearia).
The app uses .js and .jsx files. Do not generate TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) files.
